messages.content: I think I've been unfair to my partner by expecting them to read my mind.
Honestly, that's a genuinely useful realization to have. What made you notice it?
They said they wished I'd just tell them what I need instead of hinting.
That's honestly really valid feedback from them, even if it stung a bit to hear. Hinting puts a lot of unfair pressure on the other person to guess correctly.
I think I do it because asking directly feels vulnerable.
That makes a lot of sense, honestly - but the vulnerability of asking directly is usually smaller than the resentment that builds when needs go unmet silently.
